problem.title: Minimum Window Substring
problem.statement: Given two strings: source and target. Find the shortest substring of source that contains all characters from target (including their counts). If none exists, return an empty string.
problem.hint: Expand the window to the right until all target characters are covered. Once covered, try shrinking from the left to find a shorter one. When can the window be shrunk?
problem.walkthrough:
Example source = ADOBECODEBANC, target = ABC.

Find A, B, C in source:
Expand window from left:
A (0): has A. Needs: A=0, B=1, C=1
D (1): not target.
O (2): not target.
B (3): has B. Needs: A=0, B=0, C=1
C (4): has C. Needs: A=0, B=0, C=0

All covered! Current window = ADOBEC, length 6.
Now shrink from left:
Remove A: needs A=1, window invalid. Record length 6.
Start from D, expand again until all covered...
...Finally window BANC (length 4) is the shortest.

Key insight: expand until valid, then shrink until almost invalid. Repeat.
